title: Swimming lessons
intro: Lines for the pool: talking to the swimming teacher, the diploma test, and getting a six-year-old dressed and out the door on time.

notes.title: Diploma A, B and C
body: Most Dutch children work towards swimming diplomas A, B and C. The test day is called afzwemmen. Parents usually watch it from the stands, the tribune.

examples.en: She can take her swimming test next month.

cards.en: What time does the swimming lesson start?
Do you have your swimming things?

cards.nl: Ze vindt het water nog een beetje eng.
cards.en: She still finds the water a bit scary.

cards.nl: Ze moet nog oefenen met watertrappelen.
cards.en: She still needs to practise treading water.

cards.nl: Ze moet onder water door het gat zwemmen.
cards.en: She has to swim underwater through the hole.
When can she take her swimming test?

cards.nl: Is ze klaar voor diploma B?
cards.en: Is she ready for diploma B?

cards.nl: Volgende week is er geen les.
Goed gedaan! Ik ben trots op je.
cards.en: Well done! I'm proud of you.
